title: Medical Records Requests Fee Tariff Clauses
content:
**Clause 1 — Composition of the fee.** The fee on a request under Medical Records Requests is the sum of those of the request type's components that apply:

- the type's flat fee;
- the page fee, where the release is page-counted;
- the type's search fee;
- the type's certification fee;
- the type's disc fee for each disc produced;
- the type's expedite fee, when the request is expedited; and
- actual postage, where the type passes postage through.

**Clause 2 — The page fee.** The page fee of the request being fulfilled is the sum, over its pages, of the per-page rate of the band of the type's per-page bands that each page's number falls in, rounded to the cent. Each page is charged at the rate of its own band.

**Clause 3 — The cap.** Where the type's fee cap is above $0.00, the total is capped at it, the cap being applied to the last component assessed. A fee cap of $0.00 means no cap.

**Clause 4 — One assessment per component.** Each component is assessed once per request. Whether a component has already been assessed is read from the request's own fee record.

**Clause 5 — No search fee on patient access.** Patient-access request types are cost-based and never carry a search fee.

**Clause 6 — When fees are assessed.** Fees are assessed when the page count is known, at fulfillment, or, where the type requires payment before release, when the quote is issued before release.

## Components at a glance

| Component | Applies when | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Flat fee | Always | The type's flat fee |
| Page fee | The release is page-counted | Each page at its own band's rate, summed and rounded to the cent |
| Search fee | Always | The type's search fee |
| Certification fee | Always | The type's certification fee |
| Disc fee | A disc is produced | The type's disc fee for each disc |
| Expedite fee | The request is expedited | The type's expedite fee |
| Postage | The type passes postage through | Actual postage |

## Worked calculations (hypothetical fee figures, not those of any request type)

**With a cap.** A hypothetical type has a flat fee of $5.00, one per-page band of $0.25 from page 1, and a cap of $50.00; the request is not expedited and involves no postage. A release of 240 pages carries a page fee of 240 pages at $0.25, that is $60.00. The components come to $5.00 together with $60.00, that is $65.00, above the cap of $50.00, so the total is $50.00. If the page fee is the last component assessed, it is assessed at $45.00, so that the components total $50.00.

**Without a cap.** A hypothetical type has a search fee of $20.00, bands of $1.00 per page for pages 1 to 10 and $0.50 per page from page 11, and a cap of $0.00. A release of 12 pages carries a page fee of $10.00 for pages 1 to 10 and $1.00 for pages 11 and 12, that is $11.00; the total is $20.00 together with $11.00, that is $31.00, and no cap applies.

## Basis questions

**Can the same component be assessed twice on one request?** No. Each component is assessed once per request.

**On a type that requires payment before release, when is the fee assessed?** When the quote is issued before release.
